server_protect.title: Account Age Check
server_protect.thumbler1_description: Check every new member's account age on join; DM the reason and kick if it fails
server_protect.requirements: Requires the Server Members Intent to be enabled for this bot in the Discord Developer Portal.
server_protect.field1_description: New members with an account younger than this are DM'd the reason and kicked.
server_protect.field2_description: Role granted automatically to members who pass the age check. Leave as 0 to skip granting a role.
server_protect.raid_description: Detects a burst of joins in a short window and reacts.
server_protect.field3_description: Alert: posts a warning with a button only an admin can use to enable lockdown. Auto: the bot enables lockdown itself.
server_protect.field4_description: Number of joins within the time window below that counts as a raid.
server_protect.field5_description: The window joins are counted over.
server_protect.field6_description: Raid alerts and lockdown notices are posted here.
